Bills vs Vikings DraftKings Showdown Picks: Monday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Monday Night Football, November 9 · NFL Week 9 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 6, 10:40 AM ET

Josh Allen has the highest SPAGS projection in the Bills at Vikings DraftKings Showdown: 20.6 points at $11,400 FLEX, 30.9 at captain for $17,100. In a game totaled at 44.5, the model's favorite play is the quarterback who also runs. It has him carrying 6.7 times, and across 10,000 simulations he holds 71% of the winning-lineup credit. The case against Allen is his range, not his role: a simulated floor of 6.8 points at an $11,400 FLEX salary.

He also has the largest captain share: 21.9% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Allen at captain. James Cook III is the next captain in line, at 20.1%. The model gives him 19.9 carries and 2.4 targets.

Buffalo is a 3-point favorite, and the implied totals are 23.75 for the Bills and 20.75 for the Vikings.

Behind Allen and Cook, the next projections are Justin Jefferson (16.0, $9,800), Carson Wentz (15.4, $9,000) and Dalton Kincaid (11.3, $7,400).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 6, 10:40 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 10,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

MNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Josh Allen, BUF QB ($11,400 FLEX / $17,100 CPT)

Josh Allen holds 21.9% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $17,100 and the 20.6-point SPAGS model projection becomes 30.9 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 6.7 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Allen averaged 20.6 points with a simulated floor of 6.8 and a ceiling of 41.6. He holds 71% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 21.9% as the captain and 49.5% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: James Cook III, BUF RB ($10,400 FLEX / $15,600 CPT)

James Cook III holds 20.1% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $15,600 and the 17.9-point SPAGS model projection becomes 26.9 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 19.9 carries and 2.4 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Cook averaged 17.9 points with a simulated floor of 6.8 and a ceiling of 35.9. He holds 60% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 20.1% as the captain and 40.3% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Justin Jefferson, MIN WR ($9,800 FLEX / $14,700 CPT)

Justin Jefferson holds 16.7% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $14,700 and the 16.0-point SPAGS model projection becomes 23.9 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 6.4 targets on 22.0 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Jefferson averaged 15.9 points with a simulated floor of 3.5 and a ceiling of 42.1. He holds 47% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 16.7% as the captain and 29.8% in a FLEX spot.

Josh Allen leads the SPAGS model at 20.6 DraftKings points for $11,400 at FLEX, or 30.9 points at captain for $17,100.

Josh Allen is the most expensive player at $11,400 FLEX and $17,100 at captain. All 30 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Tyler Bass (8.4 points at $4,600), Will Reichard (7.9 points at $5,000) and Bills (6.3 points at $4,000).

The Bills are a 3-point favorite in a game totaled at 44.5, with implied team totals of 23.75 for the Bills and 20.75 for the Vikings.
